title: Traverse stage 1: evening approach to Passo del Vivione (camp)
terrain: hike with pack, ~800m D+, no meaningful descent
coachNotes: First effort since the fever (29 Jul). Strictly conversational - if HR drifts high for the effort or you feel feverish/chilled, stop and camp early. Real dinner at camp, warm layers, this is the recovery window before the long day. No running tonight.
